W.note: Counts 5-7-5 (cloud lens on the ridge / all the wind pours through it still / and the smell of snow); lenticular cloud evoked with a fresh smell-of-snow turn, though 'lens' is unnamed as rare.

X.note: Counts 5-7-5 (na-cre-ous glow burns / in the long dark before dawn / mother-of-pearl sky); accurate polar stratospheric nacreous cloud, but mother-of-pearl is the stock descriptor and the ending just restates.

Y.note: Counts 5-7-5 (cold cup on the sill / the lens cloud over the ridge / holds still, wind running); the domestic cup against the still lens cloud is a nice cut, though the link is loose.

Z.note: Counts 6-7-5 (moth-er-of-pearl sheets is 6), so form slips; mother-of-pearl and nacreous together are redundant and the last line is vague.
